title: End-to-side Versus Side-to-side Anastomosis With Distal Vein Ligation for Arteriovenous Fistula Creation
brief_summary: End-stage renal disease (ESRD) arises from many heterogeneous disease pathways that alter the function and structure of the kidney irreversibly, over months or years.End-stage renal disease (ESRD) arises from many heterogeneous disease pathways that alter the function and structure of the kidney irreversibly, over months or years. Haemodialysis (HD) is a lifeline therapy for patients with ESRD. Our study to compare methods of AVF creation, side to side and end to side . This randomized controlled trial .
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All renal failure patients requiring creation of arm AVF
* Including distal Radio-cephalic, Ulno-basilic, proximal brachio-cephalic or brachio-basilic configurations

Exclusion Criteria:

* Revision AVF, Synthetic graft AVF or lower limb AVF.
* Patients with absent distal pulses and chronic ischemia of the upper limb.
* Recent cannulation of puncture of the vein within 2 weeks before its use in AVF creation.
study_population: • Study population will be on Patients referred to Vascular surgery department for creation of Hemodialysis access. Patients will advised to undergo elective surgery for AVF once their renal Glomerular Filtration Rate Estimated (eGFR) is less than 15 ml/min.
